A true terror of the Umbrawells, these fortunately rare insects prowl in the darkest of recesses, forgoing sight entirely with the use of 
their highly enhanced echolocation. Solitary hunters all, they make use of their grasping scythed arms to capture and break the large 
arthropods that make their home in these bleak, unlit tunnels. A threat to even their own kind as viable hunting grounds are sparse, 
female acrynn will take daring risks to venture into the territory of males, stabbing their hard shelled eggs into crevices along the walls 
of the winding tunnels, leaving their progeny for patrolling males to fertilize. Th e healthiest males will not only leave fertilize the egg, 
but leave the partial remains of their hunts for the soon to be feasting larvae to grow strong.
